Welcome to CS 164!

We’re very excited to have you! Here are some quick tips for getting started:

  • Curious to learn more about CS 164? Check out the syllabus.
  • Want to see an overview of the course schedule? Check out the schedule.
  • Interested in learning more about us, the teaching staff? Check out the staff page.
  • Have a particular question in mind? Check out the FAQ or ask us directly at staff office hours!
  • Need to submit some homework? Do so on Gradescope.
  • Looking for the class compiler we build during class sessions? You can find it in the Class Compiler GitHub Repository.
